verdict.rationale: Semgrep mentions an 'AI-Powered Detection' capability and a named 'Semgrep Assistant (AI)' that does contextual post-processing to reduce false-positive noise, showing some built-in AI feature exists. However, evidence never shows this Assistant as an interactive agent a user can delegate open-ended tasks to (e.g., chat, remediation execution) — missing for 10: documentation of Assistant's interaction model/chat interface, examples of delegating tasks (fix generation, triage automation) beyond noise reduction, and independent hands-on confirmation of its behavior.
